title: I tried reimagining a classic cube game in 3D — would love your feedback
author: TopTrifle8319
selftext:
I wanted to experiment with a different take on the classic cube game concept by moving it into a 3D space.

I had a rough idea of what I wanted it to look and feel like, then kept iterating with AI and adjusting things until I ended up with this version.

I’m actually pretty happy with how it turned out, but I’d really love to hear what you guys think.

Does the 3D approach make the game feel more interesting, or does it make the original concept less intuitive?

Any feedback is welcome!
